_about: Measure the PALPATION landmarks the Trainer can show on the skin, from the voxel models. Rest-frame (x right, y anterior, z superior) cm from the volume centre, with the direction the landmark is felt from. Re-run after rebuilding a model.

radialStyloid.label: Radial styloid
radialStyloid.how: the most radial bone within a centimetre of the radiocarpal joint (2.2 cm proximal of the midcarpal landmark)

scaphoid.label: Scaphoid (snuffbox)
scaphoid.how: 1 cm distal to the radial styloid, felt in the anatomical snuffbox

ulnarStyloid.label: Ulnar styloid
ulnarStyloid.how: the most ulnar bone within a centimetre of the radiocarpal joint

mcp2.label: 2nd MCP joint
mcp2.how: metacarpal head 2 counted from the radial side, 0.5 cm proximal of the MCP level; felt as the knuckle on the dorsum

mcp3.label: 3rd MCP joint
mcp3.how: metacarpal head 3 counted from the radial side, 0.5 cm proximal of the MCP level; felt as the knuckle on the dorsum

medialMalleolus.label: Medial malleolus
medialMalleolus.how: the most medial bone within 1.5 cm below the ankle joint, under the tibia (the fibula is lateral 6 cm above)

lateralMalleolus.label: Lateral malleolus
lateralMalleolus.how: the most lateral bone within 3 cm below the ankle joint, under the fibula

base5th.label: Base of the 5th metatarsal
base5th.how: the most lateral bone 30-50 % of the way from the ankle to the tip of the toes (14.6 cm): the 5th metatarsal tuberosity

patella.label: Patella
patella.how: the most anterior bone within 5 cm above the knee joint

tibialTuberosity.label: Tibial tuberosity
tibialTuberosity.how: the most anterior bone 2-6 cm below the knee joint

medialEpicondyle.label: Medial epicondyle
medialEpicondyle.how: the medial end of the distal humerus section at the elbow landmark

lateralEpicondyle.label: Lateral epicondyle
lateralEpicondyle.how: the lateral end of the distal humerus section at the elbow landmark

olecranon.label: Olecranon
olecranon.how: the bone reaching furthest behind the epicondylar line 1-2 cm distal of it

mastoidR.label: Mastoid tip (R)
mastoidR.how: the lowest skull behind the atlas, 4 cm or more from the midline

gonionR.label: Angle of the mandible (R)
gonionR.how: the most posterior point of the lowest 1.5 cm of the jaw on this side (level with C3)

mastoidL.label: Mastoid tip (L)
mastoidL.how: the lowest skull behind the atlas, 4 cm or more from the midline

gonionL.label: Angle of the mandible (L)
gonionL.how: the most posterior point of the lowest 1.5 cm of the jaw on this side (level with C3)

inion.label: External occipital protuberance
inion.how: the most posterior midline point of the skull

vertebraProminens.label: Vertebra prominens (C7)
vertebraProminens.how: the tip of the C7 spinous process: the most posterior point of the C7 label

jugularNotch.label: Jugular notch
jugularNotch.how: the top of the manubrium (the sternum label), level with T2-T3

jugularNotch.label: Jugular notch
jugularNotch.how: the superior end of the sternum (the most anterior midline bone standing forward of the spine)

xiphoid.label: Xiphoid process
xiphoid.how: the inferior end of the sternum

sternalAngle.label: Sternal angle (T4-T5)
sternalAngle.how: the manubriosternal joint, taken 30 % of the way down the sternum

jugularNotch.label: Jugular notch
jugularNotch.how: the superior end of the sternum (the most anterior midline bone standing forward of the spine)

xiphoid.label: Xiphoid process
xiphoid.how: the inferior end of the sternum

sternalAngle.label: Sternal angle (T4-T5)
sternalAngle.how: the manubriosternal joint, taken 30 % of the way down the sternum

iliacCrestR.label: Iliac crest (R)
iliacCrestR.how: the highest point of the iliac crest 11-14 cm from the midline, where it is felt at the side (L4-L5)

asisR.label: ASIS (R)
asisR.how: the most anterior point of the pelvis 3 cm or more above the femoral head and 8-16 cm from the midline

trochanterR.label: Greater trochanter (R)
trochanterR.how: the most lateral bone within 4 cm below the femoral head

iliacCrestL.label: Iliac crest (L)
iliacCrestL.how: the highest point of the iliac crest 11-14 cm from the midline, where it is felt at the side (L4-L5)

asisL.label: ASIS (L)
asisL.how: the most anterior point of the pelvis 3 cm or more above the femoral head and 8-16 cm from the midline

trochanterL.label: Greater trochanter (L)
trochanterL.how: the most lateral bone within 4 cm below the femoral head

symphysis.label: Pubic symphysis
symphysis.how: the most anterior midline bone of the pelvis

costalMarginR.label: Inferior costal margin (R)
costalMarginR.how: the lowest rib 9-18 cm from the midline, above the iliac crest (about L2-L3)
